lines.en: : Chinami! Have you seen my keys anywhere?
: Chinami doesn’t know where your keys are! But she thinks it’s very possible you may have traded them for another poster of Niki based on recent character trajectory!
: Well, Chinami is wrong! Because, while big sis Chika may love Niki, she will always love you more! Oh. Here they are.
: If big sis Chika loves Chinami so much, how come there are no posters of Chinami in the house?!

: Because Chinami isn’t an idol yet. Nor is she allowed to be because big sis Chika has seen the exploitation junior idols face and doesn’t want swimsuit videos of Chinami being peddled to creepy old guys.
: But you’re dating a creepy old guy.
: And when you girls are in high school, you’ll be allowed to date creepy old guys too. But until then, you must remain pure and good and nothing like the monster I have become.
: Do you need anything before I go to work? No ordering food. There are leftovers in the fridge.
: Can you tell Chinami the Netflix password? She tried logging in to watch Breaking Bad again but it’s not “ShiningStar03!” anymore.
: That’s because I cancelled our Netflix account.
: YOU DID WHAT?!
: Well, yeah. They keep raising the prices. And I spent, like, all of my savings during a delusional shopping spree the last time we went to the mall. Gotta cut costs where I can, Chinami.
: THEN STOP COMING HOME WITH BOBA TEA AND GIVE CHINAMI HER NETFLIX BACK!
: I get those drinks from work, Chinami. And I bring you some too, so don’t make it sound like that is being financially irresponsible.
: You know I could just buy you the whole company right?
: And inherit almost seventeen billion dollars of debt in the process? No thank you! Chinami just wants her account back.
: We can use Onee-sama’s. I just have to remember which one of her horses she named her password after.
: Anything else, Chinami? Something that doesn’t involve Netflix or food or signing some sort of contract that would require me taking out a loan for a zoo?
: Yes. Chinami formally requests that you be careful walking to work and look both ways twice before crossing the street so she doesn’t need to buy a new picture frame with her zero dollars.
: Would it make you happy if I start giving you an allowance?
: Chinami loves you, big sis Chika! Have fun at work and make sure to bring her back some tea!
: Yeah, that’s what I thought. Be good, okay? Watch one of your Disney movies. You remember how to work the VCR, right?
: The what?
: Mhm! Bye-bye! Love you!
: Love you! And no touching the Niki wall! I don’t want any fingerprints on my GOD.
: Didn’t she completely lay into you during your Dorm Wars thing? Chinami said she did. You still like her anyway?
: Of course! Niki was just trying to help me get my life back on track! Which is why I now owe her both my body and my mind. And people say to never meet your idols! HA!
: ANYWAY, BYE. DON’T TOUCH THE WALL.
: It’s a step in the right direction. Big sis Chika will get there. Chinami is sure of it.
: Maybe that Niki lady needs to talk to my family too? My mom and Onee-sama have both been kind of weird lately.
: Really? They’re not Niki fans too, are they? Chinami thought Tsukasa’s family would be too civilized for that.
: We are. And, as far as I know, nobody in my family is any sort of “fan” at all.
: But Onee-sama changed her phone wallpaper to Jeeves and my mom kissed my ear the other day. So something is definitely going on.
: Does your mom not normally kiss you? Big sis Chika kisses Chinami on the forehead all the time.
: I’m pretty sure that was the first time ever. It didn’t feel like how I thought it would.
: Chinami is sad that Tsukasa doesn’t get attention. But also, Chinami doesn’t want to keep talking about Tsukasa’s family because she’s feeling all sympathied out lately.
: Great! Me too. Well, without the sympathy part. I don’t think I’ve acquired that trait yet. I just want to talk about normal stuff today too.

: Like Breaking Bad? Because big sis Chika says it isn’t as good as Better Call Saul, but Chinami disagrees wholeheartedly and believes that having a sole deuteragonist instead of splitting that role between multiple characters is more conducive to a cohesive viewing experience that ultimately amplifies the emotional attachment viewers have to the roster and ultimately the story as a whole!
: That’s boring too. I want to talk about sex again.
: Oh.
: Of course you do.
: Well, duh! Your sister is actually teaching you about stuff now! I bet if I asked mine to do the same thing, she’d just slam the door in my face.
: True...Chinami doesn’t think she should be sharing any of that info with Tsukasa, though.
: Why? I’m technically older than you. And infinitely smarter.

: Because she specifically said “Don’t share any of this with Tsukasa no matter how many times she asks you to. Which she is definitely going to do because she is Tsukasa and somebody needs to tell her no sometimes.”
: Well, of course she would say that as she is but a lowly commoner who can’t so much as fathom the concept of a girl my age having a net worth higher than she will ever achieve!
: Hey! You’re bringing Chinami’s net worth into this too, you know!
: I am! But there is a good reason for this, Chinami! For I have something you want and you have something I want! It seems only fair that we exchange these things, doesn’t it?
: Wha- no! Maybe! I don’t know! Tsukasa’s shirt beckons Chinami’s trust, though!

: Go on. Name your price. Is it money? Real estate? Impart your wisdom unto me and I will hoist the contents of my overflowing coffers unto you! Then, you can have as many Netflix accounts as you want!
: Chinami really only needs the one.
: Well, how much is that? Like...¥100,000 a month or something?
: Yes.
: Then it is settled! I will pay for your Netflix account and, in return, you will teach me everything your teacher teaches you about sex! And I won’t need to put Jeeves in danger at all!
: Danger? How would Tsukasa put Chinami’s papa in danger?
: This isn’t something for you to worry about, Chinami! Now, tell me why westerners always laugh at the word “bukkake!”
: Uhh...Chinami doesn’t think her lessons have covered that yet...
: Well, what have they covered? Because my only experiences with sexual education involve really boring slide shows and also making your adoptive father hate me.
: Well...big sis Chika has really only told Chinami about...what it is and...why people do it. Which is kind of stuff she knew already, but she doesn’t really get what else she wants to know, so...
: Well, why do they do it then? Because the logistics of sexual intercourse make enough sense to me. It’s understanding the feelings of everyone involved that confuses me.

: Chinami was confused about that too until she had a weird dream about a rabbit. But if it’s anything like big sis Chika and Papa, then...I think it’s just something people want to do when they really like each other.
: So it’s akin to a compulsion? That would explain why Jeeves took his teacher friend into my room and made her scream like I have never heard a person scream before.
: Well, apart from your sister. Who I have heard screaming the same way on several occasions now. Perhaps even louder. Can one’s emotions truly amplify sensations to that extent, though?
: Wh...Why do you have to be so close to Chinami while asking this?
: Because we like each other but we don’t want to have sex! And I’m trying to figure out why! What is it that causes the sort of attraction your sister and Jeeves have to one another?
: Ch...Chinami doesn’t even really understand how two girls can have sex yet either! She just knows they do sometimes!
: Wait, yeah. What the heck? Like, I already know about the gays. But maybe I don’t know as much about sexual logistics as I thought I did in that specific...segment of the sexual world?

: Or even the reason two girls would be attracted to each other sexually in the first place when I was under the assumption that female arousal was just the desire to have a man put his penis inside of you.
: I...um...Well, Chinami thinks that maybe sometimes...people just...do?
: Big sis Chika told Chinami that...she is attracted to both boys and girls. But she couldn’t really explain why. So there’s probably no real...logic to it and it’s...something that just happens...
: How do you know then? Which one you’re attracted to, I mean. Because I don’t think I’ve ever really felt that way about anybody before.

: Well...big sis Chika also mentioned that sometimes, people just...aren’t interested in anybody that way. I think she called it, like...asexual? Or was that pansexual? There were too many. Chinami forgot them all.
: Wait a second! You mean to tell me there’s a chance I might just never be attracted to anybody?! That’s not fair at all!
: W-W-W-W-Why is that not fair?! P...People are born the way they’re born, Tsukasa! Chinami would rather be asexual or pansexual than permanently almost-sick!
: Well, yeah! That’s unfair too! But I always figured the gays were just choosing who they liked based on extenuating circumstances like not being able to attract the sex they actually want!
: Chinami’s not surprised by this evaluation at all based on the fact that Tsukasa is rich and rich people are normally bad!
: Since when?!
: Always! Why do you think there are so few of you and so many of me?!
: Hard work and perseverance!
: You really need to get out of the house more.
: Chinami, we need to kiss.
: WE NEED TO WHAT?!
: Kiss me or you aren’t my friend! I need to figure out if I’m one of the gays!
: Or we could just, you know, not do that!
: Don’t you want to know too, though?! Because we’ve both never experienced anything like what your sister or Onee-sama or Jeeves’ teacher friend have! Maybe we’re both gays! Or something even worse!
: There’s nothing wrong with any sexuality, Tsukasa! And stop calling them “the gays!” It’s rude! Probably!
: Come on! Just once! And if we don’t feel anything, we’ll know for sure that we’re regular!
: Don’t call heterosexual people “regular” either!
: I just mean from a statistic perspective! I’m sure there are plenty of good gays out there! And, for all we know, we could be two of them! Which is exactly why we need to kiss!
: B-B-B-B-B-But what if we’re not! Then won’t it be gross?! Or...what if you have germs?! What if you kill Chinami?! How will you be able to live with yourself with my blood on your hands?!
: That’s a problem for another day!
: Easy for you to say! You’re still alive!

: Chinami, please! I don’t want to wait until I’m married to some random rich guy to find out who I like! My time is running out quicker than even yours is! You don’t want to die a kiss-virgin, do you?!
: Well...no! But Chinami always thought her first kiss would be a lot more romantic than helping her friend find out if she’s a lesbian!
: I’d do it for you.
: You’re the only real friend I’ve ever had, Chinami. Which is the only reason I feel comfortable doing this with you in the first place.
: I won’t get you sick. And if we hate it, which we very well might, we never even have to talk about it again. It’s just an experiment. People do things like this all the time. Maybe.
: Maybe?!
: I don’t know! I just know that everybody’s growing up faster than we are and that we’re the ones getting left out because of it!
: And maybe you’re fine with that, but I’m not! I don’t have the luxury of waiting! I need to grow up now or everything I know is going to get way scarier and way harder! So please-
: GAAAAAAAH! FINE! BUT ONLY BECAUSE YOU’RE GOING TO GIVE ME ¥100,000 A MONTH UNTIL ONE OF US DIES! NOT BECAUSE I LIKE GIRLS OR ANYTHING!
: Mmh...
: Mh?!
: Ahh...ahn...
: W-W-W-W-W-W-W-W-WHAT THE HECK IS THAT?! WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO DO TO ME, YOU FREAK?!
: What? That’s how they always do it in porn.
: PORN?!
: Yes! Have you not been studying the reference material I send you? You need to use your tongue. Anything less than that is going to make your partner think you’re inexperienced and scare them off.
: WE ARE INEXPERIENCED! THAT’S THE WHOLE REASON I AGREED TO THIS IN THE FIRST PLACE!
: Well, hey! On the bright side! I didn’t hate it!
: Oh boy. Congratulations...
: But I didn’t really love it either...so I’m not really sure what this means for me for going forward.
: Tsukasa...I don’t think it has to mean anything yet.
: But time is-

: Chinami knows you think time is running out. And Chinami understands more than anyone how scary that is. But...she thinks forcing yourself to grow up faster because you’re afraid of that isn’t the answer.
: Why? I don’t get it.
: Because you’ll miss out on everything else life has to offer.
: Which is what? Being neglected? Overlooked? Treated like a bargaining chip meant to somehow elevate my family’s status even further up when it already towers over everything?
: Tsukasa...
: You think I’d be doing this if I was happy with how things are? No. I’m doing this because it’s something new. Something I’ve seen make other people happy. So why not me?...
: Why can’t I?
: Now, if we could just try that one more time but with you also using your tongue-
: Chinami is going to watch Breaking Bad now. Please send her the money you promised.
: Can we practice again later?
: No.
: Tomorrow?
: No.
: Fine. Then I guess I’ll just have to practice with Jeeves.
: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
That wouldn’t be the last time the two of them kiss — just the last time for a while.
And while one of them was still unsure about what this meant, it confirmed something for the other.
The experiment worked somehow.
Just not in the way that was intended.
